newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-TOLARAM SAYS INVESTING US$7 MLN IN PAPER PLANT.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-TOLARAM SAYS INVESTING US$7 MLN IN PAPER PLANT.

text.p: Tolaram Investments, a unit of Singapore-based Tolaram Group , said on Wednesday it will invest US$7 million in its paper and cellulose plant in Kehra in north Estonia this year.

Managing director Sonny Aswani said US$4 million would be spent making a new type of kraft paper, increasing production of grocery and industrial bags, reducing production costs through better fibre recovery and on environmental issues.
The other US$3 million would be used to produce more consumer oriented products.
Aswani said the company was in the process of negotiating over these new products and could not release further details.
He said the investment would lift production of pulp, kraftliner and bags at the plant to 4,000 tonnes a month from 3,000 tonnes.
"We should be at this new level of production by August," Aswani told Reuters.
